business_problem: Texas Tech counselors and student-support teams lacked a unified view of academic, financial-aid, and wellness information, while student communications were too generic to consistently support retention and graduation goals.
solution_summary: Texas Tech built the Raider Success Hub on Experience Cloud and paired it with Einstein, Marketing Cloud, Tableau, and the broader Salesforce Platform to centralize student support and outreach. The portal gives students access to core academic information such as GPA, in-progress grades, and advisor assignments while also letting them use an Einstein chatbot to schedule appointments and find support resources without hunting through separate systems. Behind the scenes, the same platform gives counselors, faculty, and wellness coordinators a shared record of student needs, and Marketing Cloud uses website, social, and prior communication signals to personalize reminders, re-enrollment messaging, and campus resources. With analytics across recruitment, services, and engagement, Texas Tech can intervene sooner for at-risk students, close support cases faster, and make student communication feel like a coordinated journey instead of disconnected offices.
data_flow: Student academic, engagement, and support data is surfaced in the Raider Success Hub, where Einstein handles portal interactions, Marketing Cloud uses engagement history for targeted communications, and analytics help counselors coordinate timely interventions for students who need support.
business_outcome: Texas Tech improved student communication performance, shortened support-case resolution time, and created a more connected advising experience designed to lift retention and graduation outcomes.
architecture_clues: The Raider Success Hub is the shared student portal built on Experience Cloud.
Marketing Cloud personalization uses website, social, and past-engagement signals.
The Salesforce Platform is the shared record layer across recruitment, admissions, student services, advancement, and marketing.
evidence_quotes: Texas Tech created the Raider Success Hub, a one-stop student portal that runs on Experience Cloud.
This platform allows students to easily access their GPA, in-progress grades, assigned academic advisors, and more.
Texas Tech transformed its student communications with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, resulting in a remarkable 58% increase in click-through rates.
We can respond and close student support cases 65 days faster.
